mechanism: ACE inhibitors may potentiate the hypertensive effects of MAOIs through inhibition of bradykinin degradation and sympathomimetic potentiation, combined with phenelzine's inherent ability to increase norepinephrine levels.
action: Avoid concurrent use or ensure at least 14 days washout of phenelzine before initiating captopril; if combination necessary, use alternative antihypertensive and monitor blood pressure closely.
